definitions.explanation: The act of delivering ordered goods or products to a customer or client.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}{納品|のうひん}する{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: We are scheduled to deliver tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {納品|のうひん}{日|び}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
{納品|のうひん}{書|しょ}にサインをお{願|ねが}いします。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {納品|のうひん}する (to deliver goods)
- {納品|のうひん}{日|び}/{納品|のうひん}{期日|きじつ} (delivery date)
- {納品|のうひん}{書|しょ} (delivery note/slip)
- {納品|のうひん}{先|さき} (delivery destination)

RELATED TERMS:
- {出荷|しゅっか} (shipping)
- {配達|はいたつ} (delivery - general term)
